sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Add `// @grant GM_addStyle` so the shared `VZ_MBLibrary.user.js` settings/changelog dialogs (used by this script too) can inject CSS via `GM_addStyle()` instead of a plain `<style>` element, which MusicBrainz's `/account/*` pages block under Content-Security-Policy. See ShowAllEntityData's WIP.2 changelog entry for the full root-cause writeup.
